fetchLines: You remember the Fire-hardened spear at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
You remember the Work Gloves at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
fullDaySay: You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
💧 A person, maybe 30s returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 40s returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 50s returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 50s returns with water: +4 clean.
"Hey." A man, maybe 60s settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 60s.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A person, maybe 60s, with a crooked nose is humming something. It stops when they notice you listening.
A man, maybe 40s, with a gap-toothed grin came back with 805 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Rafael and Lidia lingered over the fire together.
You remember the Fire-hardened spear at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
You remember the Work Gloves at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
🔧 Technique learned: tick removal.
A person, maybe 60s, with a crooked nose watches you scratch at your ankle and shakes their head. “Here — tweezers at the head, steady pull, don’t twist. Like this.” (You learned tick removal.)
— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
👀 Someone asks the person in their 60s, with a crooked nose, the trail crew lead a shop-talk question about trail crew lead work. The pause before the answer is long enough to hear.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A person, maybe 60s, with a crooked nose).
A person, maybe 60s, with a crooked nose will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a crooked nose — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 60s speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
"Nora," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Nora." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Nora).
"Naran," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Naran." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Naran).
"Rafael," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Rafael." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Rafael).
You eat Dried meat and Trail mix (1400 kcal).
Your chewing echoes off the trees. Something out there heard. (encounters more likely tomorrow)
You take 4 logs from the woodpile for the road home. (11 left for the hearth.)
You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You step into the Haven hall.
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a crooked nose — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
"Mario," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Mario." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Mario).
"Wolfgang," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Wolfgang." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Wolfgang).

Travel 1 tile to creek.
— Moving water —
The creek braids around gravel bars. Crawdads flick backward into the shadows of rocks.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.
✅ You saw the creek. Nora nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)
You catch fragments by the fire — Rafael telling A man, maybe 50s about A person, maybe 60s, with a crooked nose. The retelling is already better than the event.
Unfamiliar unknown shoots — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Journal: Slow water. The cattails stand thick.
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND **Green Thumb, Literally**. It resonates with: something unnamed, something unnamed.
A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 5× unknown shoots. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
1 unprocessed haul onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Someone by the fire nods at the counter. "We pool food here. Keep what you need for the road — the rest feeds everyone, once it's food."
Nobody at the fire knows your haul any better than you do. It'll be your own hands that teach you.
You walk back into Haven. 4 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
A person, maybe 60s, with a crooked nose picks through the bag, frowning. Nothing they can name with confidence. (8 ticks)
You break ground behind the hall — bed 3 of 4, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 4 of 4, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 50s telling Mario about A person, maybe 60s, with a crooked nose. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a gap-toothed grin returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 50s returns with water: +3 clean.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1020 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
Quiet mending sounds from the bunks — Naran fixing something.
★ IDENTIFIED (maybe): Pineapple. A man, maybe 50s is sure — "Pineapple, see the leaves?" — and you have no reason to doubt them. Yet.
📓 Journal: A man, maybe 50s taught me Pineapple (fireside).

A man, maybe 50s passes a low bushy plant with paired oval leaves; nuts underground around the fire — calling it "Pineapple" like they've always known. The others nod along, and just like that the wrong name is loose in the village.

A person, maybe 60s, with a crooked nose spends the afternoon with the low succulent mat, reddish stems, paddle-shaped leaves — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.
From the lumped bag: Purslane — named, and out.
★ IDENTIFIED: Purslane. Succulent reddish stems, paddle leaves. Grows flat. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
💡 You see it again in your mind: low succulent mat, reddish stems, paddle-shaped leaves. A person, maybe 60s, with a crooked nose's words land on the memory like a label. Purslane. Of course.
A man, maybe 50s was watching. Now they know Purslane too.
Naran came back with 365 kcal of something edible. The pantry can't take it all — 183 kcal in, 182 kcal eaten at the fire.
Zacharie and Mario lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ Naran leaves the surplus by the fire for whoever's hungry. "The pantry can't take it. We can."
📓 Journal: Mario taught Rafael Old World Caches.
— DAY 4 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, unknown shoots went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Purslane — named and noted.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a crooked nose — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
Wolfgang watches you give the order. "Interesting. Nobody asked me."
📋 Mario — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
"Got it," Wolfgang says flatly. "Orders are orders. Whoever gives them."
You are full enough.
The pantry is in the hall. Your hands are not.
Walking 5 squares (10 kcal)…
You step into the Haven hall.
Travel 1 tile to creek.
Movement — a small fish flashing in the water.
👁 One splash and it's gone. Corner it away from the water.
✅ You saw the creek. A woman, maybe 50s nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

Travel 2 tiles to grove.
— Nut trees —
The canopy here is a roof built by a thousand architects who never met. Light comes through in coins.
Unfamiliar unknown nuts — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
A sturdy stick (crafting material).
Journal: Riparian ground. Water means life, and lunch.

A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 3× unknown nuts. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) You also gather deadfall: 1× branches. This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
1 unprocessed haul onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Nobody at the fire knows your haul any better than you do. It'll be your own hands that teach you.

Mario will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a crooked nose — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Mario — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
Wolfgang mutters something under their breath. You catch only the last word: "again."
"Enough," Wolfgang says. "I want a say in how this village runs. A real say."
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 40s speaks 🇷🇺 Russian. You share no language at all.
They point at themself and say it slowly, twice. It sounds like a name: Lidia.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Lidia).
Lidia speaks only 🇷🇺 Russian. No shared words at all — just eyes, hands, and patience.
(They mime walking — pointing at themselves, then at you, then toward the tree line. The meaning is unmistakable: come with me.)

You step into the Haven hall.
Travel 1 tile to creek.
✅ You saw the creek. Naran nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)
You catch fragments by the fire — Naran telling A woman, maybe 50s about A woman, maybe 30s. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s telling Nora about you. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
You catch fragments by the fire — Lidia telling Mario about Nora. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 2 tiles to grove.
Movement — a great horned owl, silent and huge.
👁 It waits for YOU to come close — the stillness is the trap. Spot the shape before you're in reach, and strike first. It only gets one.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

Travel 2 tiles to meadow.
— Open ground —
The grass is bent in a long smooth run, like something heavy slid through it. You walk the other way around.
Something moves out there — a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
You walk back into Haven. 7 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a crooked nose — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
Wolfgang mutters something under their breath. You catch only the last word: "again."
📋 Mario — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 30s speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
"Ava," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Ava." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Ava).

Wolfgang leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong. Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📓 Journal: Counter: Hit it while it folds — The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it.

You step into the Haven hall.
